message.content: Proposed 3 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: Polish academic English across intro/method/appendix: unify terminology to "trajectory tracking", fix appendix grammar and split the run-on sentence, light register polish in intro and method; formulas and refs unchanged.

hunks.oldText: Our trajectory method has a clear weakness: it degrades when observations are delayed. Figure~\ref{fig:tracking} reports the comparison.
hunks.newText: The proposed trajectory-tracking method has a clear limitation: its performance degrades when observations are delayed. Figure~\ref{fig:tracking} reports the comparison.

hunks.oldText: We study trajectory tracking under the parameter restriction $\tau=0.5$. The controller does not claim robustness beyond this range.
hunks.newText: We study trajectory tracking under the parameter restriction $\tau=0.5$. The controller makes no claim of robustness beyond this range.

hunks.oldText: The proof use same trajectory track restriction $\tau=0.5$ and it not claim robustness outside this range.
hunks.newText: The proof uses the same trajectory-tracking restriction $\tau=0.5$. It does not claim robustness outside this range.
